title: Model Settings UI
outcome_summary: Implemented a fully GUI-managed model registry and per-persona model assignment system, replacing hardcoded YAML-only model configuration. A new file-based registry at personas/model-registry/ (default.json, local.json, assignments.json) drives model selection across all three persona suites (ledger, standalone, ledger-support), with a five-step priority chain consumed by both the build system and orchestrator. The GUI Configuration screen was restructured with three tabs (General, Persona Models, Model Registry) backed by 8 new REST endpoints; all 10 WPs passed all pipeline stages with 2 rework cycles resolved cleanly, 3,500+ regression tests passing, and a security audit finding no critical or high issues.
project_summary: Implement configurable model settings for the persona system, replacing hardcoded YAML-only model configuration with a GUI-managed model registry and per-persona model assignment system. Users can register available models, assign them to individual personas across all three suites (ledger, standalone, ledger-support), and set a default model through the GUI Configuration screen restructured with tabs. The model assignments are consumed by the persona build system and orchestrator with a clear priority chain: user assignments > per-persona YAML > shared YAML default.
